question: As of November 2020, The Saraswati Samman is an annual award given for outstanding prose or poetry literary works in any of the ______ Indian languages listed in Schedule VIII of the Constitution of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**22**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Saraswati Samman **is an annual award given for outstanding prose or poetry literary works in **22 Indian Languages**.
 
• The Saraswati Samman is an annual award for poetry literary works in any 22 Indian languages listed in** Schedule VIII** of the Constitution of India.
 
• **Ramdarsh Mishra** was honoured with Saraswati Samman for** 2021** for his collection of poems '**In Toh Here Hoon**' on April 7, 2022.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Saraswati Samman**

 
 
• Date: 1991
 
• First winner: Harivansh Rai Bachchan
 
• Location: Delhi
 
• Most recent winner: Ram Darash Mishra
 
• Reward(s): ₹15,00,000
 
• Sponsored by: K. K. Birla Foundation
